metric: Absolute stock-to-texture boundary error at 488x680. Not a whole-card accuracy score.
policy:
Measure stock-to-texture transitions on frozen poses, independently of text/art.
Fit a blurred step plus interior texture slope on averaged RGB edge profiles.
No per-card render parameters; calibration and validation cohorts remain frozen.

validation.unmeasured: Black frame edge contrast is too low for this step estimator. Green top transitions are contaminated by the title bevel; retain the shared fit and flag these samples.

selection: The same outer-band mapping applies to all five pinned PLC colorshifted sources. Rounded quarter-pixel controls were fitted on the 15 existing calibration scans; no per-card render corrections or pose changes. Fit uses high-contrast outer edges; low-contrast black and contaminated green-top measurements are omitted from the numeric summary.
caveats: Black source has prominent light-gray inner bevels absent or much weaker in the printing. Track as a source-asset mismatch; keep independent from outer-edge geometry and ink-floor curves.
Vampiric Link remains outside this cohort because of its existing rejected scan normalization.
